periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertical orientation with a slight outward tilt of approximately 15-20 degrees from the vertical midline of the face.

periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lowest point extending well below the geometric center toward the muzzle.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation across the cranial vault.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly convex and rounded at the superior boundaries.
